# Australian Sports Commission

> The Australian Sports Commission (ASC) and Australian Institute of Sport (AIS) develop elite athletes, support high-performance programs, and promote sports participation across Australia.

ASC is Australia's government sports agency responsible for athlete development, coaching support, and community sports initiatives. The site features the AIS Podium Project infrastructure redevelopment for Brisbane 2032, high-performance resources, and participation programs like Sporting Schools.

## Key Topics

- Australian Institute of Sport (AIS)
- High-performance sports
- Athlete development
- Sports coaching
- Sporting Schools
- AIS Podium Project
- Australian Paralympic Team
- Performance support
- Sport volunteering
- Concussion safety protocols
- Elite athlete programs
- Sport sector resources
- Brisbane 2032 Olympics
- Women in coaching
- Community sports participation

## Core Programs & Initiatives

- [Australian Sports Commission](https://www.ausport.gov.au): Homepage for ASC and AIS, showcasing high-performance sports programs
- [High Performance](https://www.ausport.gov.au/guidance-and-resources/high-performance): High-performance athlete development, coaching, and support resources
- [Sporting Schools](https://www.ausport.gov.au/schools): Government initiative for school sports participation and community connections
- [AIS Podium Project](https://www.ausport.gov.au/ais-podium-project): AIS infrastructure redevelopment project for Brisbane 2032 Olympics
- [Volunteering](https://www.ausport.gov.au/volunteering): Sport volunteering opportunities and volunteer resource information

## Safety & Health Guidelines

- [Concussion in sport](https://www.ausport.gov.au/concussion): Evidence-based Australian Concussion in Sport guidelines and safety protocols

## News & Updates

- [News](https://www.ausport.gov.au/media-centre/news): News feed covering AIS announcements and Australian sports updates
- [New AIS program supporting the experts behind Australia's athletes](https://www.ausport.gov.au/media-centre/news/new-ais-program-supporting-the-experts-behind-australias-athletes): News article on AIS professional development program for performance support
- [2026 Women in Coaching Talent Program Cohort Connects in Brisbane](https://www.ausport.gov.au/media-centre/news/2026women-in-coaching-talent-program-cohort-connects-in-brisbane): News on AIS Women's Talent Coach Program and elite female coaches
- [Milestones and medals for Aussies at Winter Paralympics](https://www.ausport.gov.au/media-centre/news/milestonesandmedalsforaussies): News coverage of Australian Paralympic Team at Milano Cortina 2026

## Information & Resources

- [About us](https://www.ausport.gov.au/about): ASC organization overview, governance, values, and engagement info
- [Clearinghouse](https://www.ausport.gov.au/clearinghouse): Information and knowledge sharing platform with sport research and data
- [Contacts](https://www.ausport.gov.au/contacts): Contact directory for ASC and AIS departments and locations

## Optional

- [Careers](https://www.ausport.gov.au/careers): Employment opportunities at ASC combining sport passion with work
- [Visit AIS](https://www.ausport.gov.au/ais/visit): Visitor information for AIS facilities including tours and events
